reviewer: Claude record and caption comparison; not a radiologist review
decision: On 2026-11-18 the project owner asked for the malformed figure-record context codes to be repaired.
rule: A context value the fidelity checker cannot read is rewritten in the evidence ledger into the checker’s vocabulary with the same meaning. Where the old code did not say what the figure shows, the figure was looked at and its caption read. No binding, coverage, review status, caption or pixel changes.
catalog: The app’s figure catalog keeps the packaging scripts’ original codes. The app reads none of the repaired fields, and the catalog copy is pinned by reader digests, lesson contracts and the saved fidelity scope; catalog_mirror marks the records whose catalog row still holds the ledger’s pre-repair context.

rules.extent_vocabulary: An extent written in the packaging script’s own words (“source_local_views”, “source_obtained_only”, a single local MPR, separate local examples, or “conceptual” on a schematic) becomes “local”, the ledger’s value for a figure that shows part of a structure.
rules.setting_vocabulary: An illustration is recorded with the setting “conceptual”, as the ledger’s other 48 schematics are.
rules.laterality_vocabulary: “not_applicable” and “not_independently_verified” become “not_reported”, the ledger’s value for a record that states no side; the checker treats both the same way.
rules.laterality_stated: A side the record called publisher-assigned becomes that side where the published caption itself states it.
rules.state_lowercase: A state code with capital letters is written in lower case. The figure was checked to show what the code says.
rules.state_reviewed: The old code did not say what the figure shows; the new code does (normal anatomy, an anatomical variant, or a named disease).
rules.state_mixed_panels: The record’s own selected panels show different states, so the figure-level state is “mixed”, as on 18 other records.
rules.state_same_meaning: The figure-level state and the single panel state said the same thing in different words; the figure-level state takes the panel’s code.
rules.prose_to_record: A sentence stored where a context record belongs becomes a record holding only what the sentence states, with the sentence kept as a note.
